instructions: Read README.md and docs/artifacts.md. Retain the native Electron Forge and embedded-guide workflows. Stop development, compilation, packaging and smoke jobs first. These rules do not authorize deletion.

rules.name: compiled-output
rules.instructions: Wrapper compilation and asset generation reproduce these directories during npm start/package/make. Confirm no active app, package or review needs them. Preview with the shared clean-generated helper; apply needs authorized project-root writes for isolation. Keep embedded guide source and assets intact.

rules.name: packages-and-smoke-evidence
rules.instructions: Separate rebuildable Forge packages from retained releases and out/test-results/electron-smoke.png or other review captures. Preserve useful verification evidence with known revision, caption and checksum before proposing exact removals. Use bounded Luna high/standard classification when useful. Never remove the entire out root based on age or an ignore rule.
